ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated in mottled clusters on the lateral distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling is localized on the far left and far right tips; the medial area surrounding the notch is a solid low-intensity black void; sparse high-intensity speckling occurs across the mid-lateral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary trailing edge displays low-amplitude, smooth topography; high-frequency, jagged pixel-amplitude variations are concentrated at the far lateral tips due to irregular surface growths.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the upper margin, tapering to narrow, acute terminal points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast textured clusters of brownish-white pixels localized on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks visible on the mid-section of the right lobe, cutting across the primary black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting calcified texture localized on the lateral fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible circular 'O' shaped high-intensity ring mark located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
